response.overview: Produced in the 1960s by the Calvin Company, "The Universe and Other Things" was created to promote consulting engineers and aims to define what they do, as their role is often misunderstood. It highlights their rigorous training, professionalism, and the wide range of complex problems they solve. Consulting engineers are portrayed as generalists who apply scientific thinking to practical solutions, working within time and budget constraints. They are involved in diverse projects, from designing medical equipment to addressing global issues like pollution and urban decay. The script emphasizes their crucial role in shaping the future and improving people's lives, even though their contributions often go unrecognized.
response.title: The Universe and Other Things
